The Author 
Marc Bloch, one of the great historians of our time, was born at Lyons 
in 1886 and educated at the Ecole Normale in Paris.

text: He was for many years Professor of Medieval History in the University of Strasbourg before being called to the Chair of Economic History at the Sorbonne in 1936.

text: During the war he joined the Resistance, but was caught by the Gestapo, tortured, and shot near Lyons in June 1944.
